topic: SAA multi-station decay — re-verification after ISS-2599/ISS-2600 self-apply patches
our_argument_summary: WIN-041 verdict Misleading: multi-station observation of the single SAA regional anomaly is one confirmation, not five; same INTERMAGNET/CHAOS-7 observational basis as WIN-004/005/035/037. The dome field equation H(r)=8537*exp(-r/8619) is azimuthally symmetric and cannot produce the between-cell decay maximum. Post-hoc: no monitor.py domain covers the five-station claim; Domain 8 is a single-station (TTB) hardcoded 77.0/77.0 identity.

relevant_files: raw-text/08-live-power.txt (Domain: SAA Decay Rate block, lines 228-230)
dome_code_analysis.calculation_pipeline: Live-power page (raw-text/08-live-power.txt:228-230) confirms this run: Domain SAA Decay Rate shows Predicted: 77.0 nT/yr | Observed: 77.0 nT/yr | Tolerance: 20.0% | Status: PASS, Source: INTERMAGNET TTB annual means. A predicted=observed identity at a single station; nothing computes the five-station graded-rate claim.
dome_code_analysis.hardcoded_vs_computed: Display identity — predicted equals observed to the decimal, which is the signature of a value copied from the data into the prediction field. The 20% tolerance is decorative when pred==obs by construction.
data_sources_used: INTERMAGNET TTB annual means (per dome label)
dome_code_analysis.escape_clauses: 20% tolerance on a pred==obs identity is unfalsifiable as configured; raw-text/08-live-power.txt:294 notes SAA Decay uses 20% among the wide tolerances.
dome_code_analysis.code_discrepancies: None found this run. Note: monitor.py is no longer present in raw-text/ (folder now carries page dumps only); the c5 line-489 citation of the Tsumeb-TTB comment could not be re-verified directly, but the live-power Domain block independently confirms the single-station TTB + 77.0/77.0 structure our prose describes.

code_analysis_tags.monitoring_evidence: No domain covers the five-station claim that constitutes WIN-041. The only SAA-decay domain checks one station (TTB) against a hardcoded predicted=77.0/observed=77.0 identity (raw-text/08-live-power.txt:228-230). Per the validation checklist, fetched-data-vs-hardcoded-threshold and pred==obs identities do not qualify as live_fetch for the WIN as claimed; for the five-station claim specifically there is no monitoring at all.
code_analysis_tags.relabels_standard_evidence: SAA decay and its spatial structure are standard geomagnetism: reversed-flux-patch growth at the CMB (Terra-Nova et al. 2017, doi:10.1016/j.pepi.2017.03.002) and CHAOS-7 SV maps (Finlay et al. 2020, doi:10.1186/s40623-020-01252-9). The dome renames core dynamics as aetheric boundary separation while adopting the same observations.
code_analysis_tags.post_hoc_evidence: INTERMAGNET station archives were public and indexed before the dome monitor commit; the dome adopted observed rates as its prediction (77.0/77.0 identity). No pre-registration in an author-independent timestamping venue located.
code_analysis_tags.derives_from_dome_evidence: The dome field equation H(r)=8537*exp(-r/8619) depends only on radial distance and is azimuthally symmetric — it cannot derive a longitude-structured between-cell decay maximum, and the >=28 nT/yr threshold is not derived from any dome-geometry equation.

ISS-2599.evidence: detail_verdict_text now reads: a single station (TTB — Tatuoca, Brazil; the dome code comment mislabels it Tsumeb) — exactly the c5 recommendation. Converts the inherited mislabel into an accuracy finding against the dome pipeline. Companion issue ISS-2605 (WIN-037 same mislabel) confirmed open in monitor/decisions/open-issues.json.

ISS-2600.evidence: The word precisely no longer appears anywhere in WIN-041 user-visible fields (grep verified across claim, finding, detail_evidence, detail_verdict_text, both tldrs). Finlay clause now reads: place the fastest decline in the region between the separating cells.

kernel_of_truth.description: The graded decay rates across SAA-region stations are real measurements of real spatial structure in geomagnetic secular variation (wins.json:WIN-041.detail_evidence acknowledges the decay rates are real physical observations), and the dome author did assemble multi-station INTERMAGNET pulls (2022-2024) rather than inventing numbers.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Correlated samples of one coherent regional anomaly do not multiply into independent confirmations (wins.json:WIN-041.detail_verdict_text, thermometer analogy), and the spatial structure the dome calls inexplicable is positively predicted by reversed-flux-patch dynamics (doi:10.1016/j.pepi.2017.03.002) while the dome own azimuthally-symmetric H(r) cannot produce it (wins.json:WIN-041.detail_verdict_text para 2).

deeper_analysis: Verification-class re-review of the two c5 holes. Both patches applied exactly as recommended, with no collateral damage: the TTB parenthetical is factually correct (TTB is the IAGA code for Tatuoca, Belem, Brazil — verified in c5 against the INTERMAGNET GIN station list; the live-power page label INTERMAGNET TTB annual means is consistent), grammatically clean in its host sentence, and strengthens rather than weakens the post-hoc argument by documenting a dome-side accuracy error. The precisely deletion brings the Finlay et al. 2020 characterization back inside what the citation supports. Fingerprint delta from c5 confirms surgical edits: detail_verdict_length 2848->2892 (+44 = +54 parenthetical expansion -10 precisely removal), all other fields byte-identical. Adversarial pass on the patched text found no new attack surface: a defender could try to dismiss the mislabel point as a mere comment typo, but our prose already frames it proportionately (mislabels, not falsifies) and the load-bearing claim — single-station hardcoded identity vs a five-station WIN — stands independently on the live-power Domain block re-verified this run.
